why: Adamic, task m2wxyaz: the three slots are readonly, certified by the compiled program's gate, not by adaptation 70's audit. Code that assigns file, start or length on a Diagnostic or a DiagnosticRelatedInformation stops type-checking (TS2540); code that reads them is unaffected; a DiagnosticWithLocation stays writable until its own slice.
